errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the secondary right y-axis (percentage) as the main vertical axis for the bars. The primary left y-axis, which represents the cost in Euros (€) for the bars, is not mentioned.
The description completely omits the primary left vertical axis, which shows the energy cost in Euros (€) from 0€ to 3,000€.
The legend in the image clearly indicates that the blue color represents "Електроенергия" (Electricity), not "Енергия за отопление" (Heating energy).

The legend shows that solid fuels ("Твърди горива") are represented by the color purple, not orange. The description also uses the singular form "Твърд гориво" instead of the plural shown in the legend.

The legend indicates that natural gas ("Природен газ") is represented by the color red, not green. The green color represents liquid fuels ("Течни горива"), which is a category missed by the description.
This category does not exist in the chart's legend or anywhere in the figure.

The description incorrectly identifies this as a component of the stacked bars. In the chart, this label corresponds to the orange diamond-shaped markers of the scatter plot, which use the secondary (right) y-axis.

errors.evidence: The total values of the bars (total energy cost) range from approximately 250€ (for LV) to approximately 2,600€ (for DK). No bar has a value near 0€, and none exceed 3,000€.
